decisions.evidence: Reader 10's repaired substitution proof still stands, but the current carrier is now an amended repair: Alpha also tightened the lemma statement so the displayed B-productions are explicitly exhaustive and synchronized the batch-10 strategy row to the nonadjacent context-rewrite proof.

Reader 10's two-phase GNF repair still stands, but the live carrier is an amended repair because Alpha also corrected the theorem's [L2] citation to the exhaustive substitution form, refreshed the batch-10 strategy row, and wrote the required risk_review in the contract entry.

The refuter was correct that finitely branching alone allowed an infinite A-chain to count as a parse tree. The current definition now requires the tree itself to be finite, so that counterexample is no longer admitted.

The refuter was correct that the old equivalence failed once infinite parse trees were allowed. The current theorem now works over finite parse trees only, records epsilon-productions explicitly, and makes the parse-tree-to-derivation construction terminate.

The refuter was correct that the old ambiguity clause inherited the false parse-tree equivalence. The current definition now states the equivalence using finite parse trees, matching the repaired correspondence theorem it cites.

The refuter was correct that the old example invoked acceptance without defining an accepting set. The current example now specifies q_0 as the start state and F = {q_3}, so the final appeal to the DFA acceptance definition is licensed.

The refuter was correct that the old homomorphism proof omitted the disjointness step needed to keep the rewritten grammar over Delta. The current proof first renames the source variables away from Delta and only then replaces terminals by h(a), so the construction is again a valid CFG.

The refuter was correct that the old [L2] inflated the substitution lemma beyond what its statement licensed. The current theorem now states [L2] using all productions of the leading variable, and the repaired dependency lemma now makes that exhaustiveness explicit.
